{{Top|leg}}
The '''Anti-Sedition Provision''' was a provision of the [[Galactic Loyalty Act]] regarding [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] activity during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Any being found to have allowed any [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] sympathizer to speak at a public forum was subject to punishment under this part of the act. Conviction could result in imprisonment in a [[MaxSec Orbital Facility]] for a term of up to twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] or until the insurrection ended. [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|GA Intelligence]] operatives [[Jae Juun]] and [[Tarfang]] threatened the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] guards at the [[Rock Council]] with it if they allowed [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to speak before the council prior to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
